data.title: 青山七海 · 晨曦榻榻米的安宁圆满依偎
data.description: 初升阳光洒满榻榻米床铺。马尾解开后的深茶长发披散在枕边，七海整个人依偎在你的怀里，小手抚摸着你的下巴，带着初尝圆满后的纯真甜笑，用关西腔轻声唤你早安。
data.location: sunlit morning tatami bedroom with warm morning glow
data.action: 马尾解开后的深茶长发披散在枕边，七海整个人依偎在你的怀里，小手抚摸着你的下巴
data.lighting: bright golden morning sunbeams pouring across tatami and sheets
data.promptProse: Nestled affectionately beside her partner across tangled white sheets on a sunlit morning futon, Nanami Aoyama wears her loose peach-and-white striped cotton henley nightdress slipped slightly off one shoulder with her long hair spread over the pillow. Gently caressing his cheek with a tender, radiant smile, she glows in warm golden morning sunbeams.
data.animaCaption: Nestled close against her partner on the rumpled morning futon with her hair loose and her striped peach cotton nightdress slipping off one shoulder, she cups his chin gently with a warm, radiant smile. Bright golden morning sunbeams fill the tatami room.
data.nsfwProse: She wears her loose peach-and-white striped cotton henley nightdress slipping casually off one bare shoulder amid the sunlit morning sheets.
